mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate reached 1.21% in June 2022, with market expectations of further hikes
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE was 3.6% in June 2022, near historical lows
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher equity valuations through improved consumption expectations and positive forward-looking earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 1531.0 in May 2022, indicating strong housing activity
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which triggers risk-off behavior and reduces equity market valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO fell to 101.018 in June 2022, signaling weakening industrial activity
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above 3.0% and 2.5% respectively signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, reducing equity risk appetite and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL was 294.957 in June 2022, indicating elevated inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the interaction term in a multivariate model has a non-significant negative coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE signals strong labor market momentum that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS rose to 152358.0 in June 2022, while UNRATE remained at 3.6%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS was 666113.0 in June 2022, indicating resilient consumption
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 660 billion, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
